identity.name: CIRCA at Clarendon
identity.notes: The packet's Arlington location is the official CIRCA at Clarendon restaurant. Official navigation and ordering explicitly separate Clarendon from Foggy Bottom, Navy Yard, and The Boro; no other CIRCA location was merged.

sources.excerpt: Official CIRCA at Clarendon page identifies 3010 Clarendon Blvd, Arlington, VA 22201 and publishes the current lunch, dinner, brunch, dessert, drink, and online-order surfaces. The navigation separately lists Clarendon, Foggy Bottom, Navy Yard, and The Boro.

Restaurant-issued CL Lunch menu dated 3.25.26. Visual review established all products and item-level contains-shellfish/contains-nuts icons, and retained the not-a-gluten-free-environment warning separately.

Restaurant-issued CL Dinner menu dated 3.26.26. Visual review established the complete dinner surface and prevented shellfish/nut/gluten-sensitive icons or optional proteins from bleeding into adjacent items.
Restaurant-issued CL Brunch menu dated 3.25.26. Visual review established complete brunch products, sides, and item-level icons and separated section headings from product names.

Restaurant-issued Clarendon beverage list dated 3.26.26. The current nonalcoholic boundary is four mocktails plus Heineken 0.0 and Athletic Brewing Run Wild IPA (N/A); alcoholic products are excluded.
Official ordering page presents distinct links for Clarendon, Foggy Bottom, Navy Yard, and The Boro and links the Clarendon location to ChowNow.

The restaurant-linked ChowNow storefront identifies CIRCA at Clarendon at 3010 Clarendon Blvd and exposes the current takeout catalog. It adds Broccolini and Crispy Brussels + Blue to the current union; the Crispy Brussels + Blue product text directly identifies blue cheese, while no comprehensive allergen matrix is provided.
Clarendon event FAQ says gluten-sensitive options are not fully gluten free because CIRCA is not a fully gluten-free kitchen and asks guests to disclose dietary restrictions.
Official-domain and BentoBox/CDN searches located current menus and the event FAQ but no item-by-allergen matrix, ingredient guide, nutrition guide, or complete may-contain document.

Targeted web searches found the official menus, linked ordering surface, OpenTable, and generic dietary mentions, but no attributable item-by-allergen matrix or more authoritative product-level disclosure.

findings.summary: The OSM Arlington record is CIRCA at Clarendon, 3010 Clarendon Blvd; official pages distinguish all other CIRCA locations.

The current logical union contains 79 food/nonalcoholic products across lunch, dinner, brunch, dessert, mocktails, nonalcoholic beer, and the restaurant-linked ChowNow takeout catalog. All are published on at least one complete current surface.

Frozen PDF rows contain spacing duplicates, a SANDWICHES heading join, and icon/add-on bleed (notably Parmesan Kale, Veg + Quinoa Bowl, and Wild Mushroom). Visual PDF review resolves these without inventing negatives.

All four required searches completed without a complete item-by-allergen matrix. Only explicit restaurant ingredient/name positives and item-level shellfish/nut icons are retained; all other product allergen fields remain unavailable.
Official not-gluten-free-environment language is retained as restaurant-level cross-contact evidence and is not converted into product-level may-contain claims.

proposedChanges: Replace the 93-row duplicate/artifact-prone baseline with the 79-product current logical union of the official Clarendon menus and restaurant-linked ChowNow catalog, including ChowNow-only Broccolini and Crispy Brussels + Blue.
Consolidate HTML/PDF spacing variants; remove the SANDWICHES heading join and alcohol-only Rosé row; normalize TO E AC HTHEIR to To Each Their Own.
Correct PDF icon and optional-protein bleed without asserting allergen absence.
Preserve only direct restaurant-issued ingredient/name/icon positives and retain the not-gluten-free-environment warning separately because no complete matrix exists.
